summary: Versatile HR professional with a strong benefits administration background and cross‑functional experience in HRIS, reporting, project management, vendor relations, regulations, employee relations, policies, training, candidate screening, and oversight.

experience.title: HR Shared Services Analyst
responsibilities: Provided customer support for HRIS questions and issues, researching and resolving policy and transactional queries related to PeopleSoft HRIS.
Assisted employees, managers, and HRBPs with inquiries and provided tier 1/2 support.
Audited and completed mass change and reorganization requests in PeopleSoft.
Performed periodic data audits and established guidelines for standard reports.
Completed HR transactional, payroll, and administrative activities as needed.
Suggested process improvements based on customer feedback.
Supported user acceptance testing of system updates and enhancements.
Conducted data audits to ensure data integrity and met reporting requests.

experience.title: Human Resources Representative
responsibilities: Administered all university benefits programs and communicated with vendors.
Maintained the Staff Compensation System and provided daily counseling on benefits and compensation.
Handled unemployment forms, exit interviews, and file reviews.
Interpreted personnel policies and provided training and outreach.
Supported retirees and backup to the Director of Human Resources Benefits & Compensation.
Recommended policy and procedure improvements.

experience.title: Benefits Manager/HRIS Specialist
responsibilities: Managed employee benefits programs and HRIS.
Documented HR processes and procedures for HRIS management.
Ensured compliance with state and federal employment and benefits law.
Oversaw benefit enrollment and served as primary contact for faculty, staff, and retirees.
Collaborated with vendors to resolve benefit issues.

experience.title: HR Specialist
responsibilities: Managed annual open enrollment and payroll-related functions.
Supervised worksheet and confirmation statement fulfillment.
Created test plans and conducted testing for the HR portal.
Maintained client research mailbox and resolved complex client issues.
Updated carrier files, imports, and exports.

experience.title: Specialist
responsibilities: Processed short‑term disability payments.
Administered leave of absence, including FMLA.
Reported metrics and maintained reporting processes.
